instruction: Email the driving license found in my file system to my partner.
notes: Three apps plus supervisor: phone (search_contacts with relationship=partner to get the partner's email), file_system (show_directory recursive with substring to locate the driving license file path; the file-system token is also passed to gmail.send_email as file_system_access_token), and gmail (send_email with the file as attachment). Static init facts link the partner person to a placeholder email object and the driving-license file to the search substring so the planner grounds the lookups; the actual values are read at runtime. Goal demands exactly one email with the attachment sent to the partner (send action guarded against duplicates) and task completion last. email_addresses and attachment_file_paths are single-element lists built from the email and file-path objects. supervisor.complete_task takes no answer since the task is not a question.

plan: (gmail-send-email partner-email subject-driving-license body-driving-license file-system-token driving-license-file file-system-token my-partner)
